messages:
jess: Heads up — I'm doing a pass to simplify the Quickstart credential matrix. Goal: consolidate auth patterns to Env var, SDK helper, and ephemeral token + add SDK6->7 migration notes. I'll open a draft PR later today.

mike: solid. can you enumerate the files you'll change?

jess: quickstart.md, snippets/auth.md, examples/hello-node/.env.example, examples/hello-python/README, and a small CI snippet test.

samir: watch for the client ctor rename in v7. we should show the 1-line diff and a before/after snippet.

jess: good point — will include code diff and a tiny migration table.

olivia: please ensure snippet-test coverage: add a smoke that runs `hello-world` with `REDWOOD_API_KEY` fallback.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs-lint failed on prior PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/892 — check link formats and code fence language.

jess: saw that. also found a dead link to `/docs/auth-flow`; I'll fix and add a redirect alias.

mike: for examples/hello-python include both sync and async snippets (most teams copy one or the other).

jess: will add both and annotate which to pick for quickstarts.

mike: think about the in-page table: keep it human-readable. maybe a compact table with a short code example per row.

samir: table + one-liner code example per cell is perfect. prevents noise.

jess: plan for PR to include: 1) condensed credential table, 2) SDK migration diff, 3) updated snippets (node/py), 4) CI snippet tests, 5) link fixes and redirects. @lee can you review when it's ready?

lee: yep — tag me. also loop in infra for the Docker credential helper note.

jess: opening WIP draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999 (WIP) — contains initial table and diff.

olivia: small note — update package refs to `@redwood/sdk` v7 in package.json examples before merge.

jess: done. ran snippet tests locally, CI shows two flaky py-async runs — marked flaky in PR but I'd like to stabilize if possible.

mike: add a short changelog entry under docs/updates.md for visibility.

jess: added changelog blurb to the PR. ready for review.

lee: left review comments — tiny wording nits and one missing badge (preview env).

jess: addressed comments, pushed commit. waiting for CI. will merge once green + one more approval.

docs-bot: deploy-preview created https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/quickstart-cred-matrix-999

samir: preview looks good — migration table reads clearly and the inline diffs are approachable.

jess: merging now. I'll watch link-test and snippet CI post-deploy for regressions.

olivia: thanks team! :tada:

mike: nice work — reduces confusion for first-time users.

jess: local follow-up: create a short follow-up issue to add a CLI example for ephemeral tokens (low priority).

lee: noted. I'll file the issue after merge.

docs-bot: Merged by jess — PR #999. Release preview will be live shortly.
